trace.note: non-global IP rejected at check time

finding.guards_checked: scheme check (connection.py:71); optional domain allowlist (connection.py:75, off by default); manual redirect re-validation (connection.py:85-90) is correct; non-global IP check defeated by TOCTOU.

finding.claim: Pickle RPC over a localhost ZMQ ROUTER socket deserializes any received bytes; exploitable only by local processes or users.
finding.source: bytes received on ROUTER socket bound to tcp://localhost random port (zmq_rpc.py:123-126)
finding.sink: pickle.loads(request_data) at zmq_rpc.py:305 (also 447, 451, 572 on client side)
finding.guards_checked: loopback-only bind; code comment warns against external exposure; no authentication on socket. Local-only, low severity on single-user hosts.
